description: Map movement, not static points. FlowPath draws a curved, weighted arrow from each origin to each destination, so volume and direction read at a glance - trade lanes, supply chains, shipments, migration, transfers, referrals, any movement between places. Built for strict data governance No geocoding service. Place names resolve against a list of 34,000 cities bundled inside the visual. No external calls, and no data leaves your report - which is also why it can be certified. Coordinates or place names. Bind latitude and longitude, or a single City|State|Country column. Mix both, and explicit coordinates take priority. Never silently wrong. A name that could mean several places is refused rather than guessed at, and rows that cannot be located are counted on the visual, with the reason on hover. Multi-hop routes. Chain legs into one route, so a shipment through three hubs reads as a journey rather than three unrelated arrows. Timeline playback and flow animation. Bind a date field and watch a network expand, shift and contract over time. Great-circle paths for long-haul lanes, crossing the antimeridian correctly rather than doubling back across the map. Divergent path widths. Give a flow a value at each end and it is drawn between the two, colored by what it gained or lost in transit. Directional highlighting. Select a hub and its inbound traffic separates from its outbound by…
